headline: Pakistan posted a current account deficit of $356 million in September 2026, against a $133 million surplus in September 2025, according to State Bank of Pakistan data.

card.desc: Deficit hits $356 million against $133 million surplus last September

caption:
Pakistan posted a current account deficit of $356 million in September 2026, compared with a surplus of $133 million a year earlier, Arab News and Business Recorder reported, citing State Bank data. The deficit for July-September reached $874 million, Business Recorder said.
